_comment: Tracking file for the DevSecOps content-expansion loop. Each batch becomes one new top-level category authored by an agent workflow, merged into seed.js. The loop picks the first 'pending' batch, authors it, marks it 'done', commits, and re-triggers itself ~2 min later until all batches are done.

batches.name: Docker — Engine & CLI
batches.description: Day-to-day Docker operations: image build/manage, container lifecycle, volumes, networks, Compose, buildx, registry, and troubleshooting.
subcategories: Images (build, tag, pull, push, prune, history, inspect)
Containers (run, exec, logs, stats, cp, commit, restart policies)
Docker Compose (up, down, scale, logs, profiles, override)
Registry & Image distribution (login, save/load, skopeo, crane)
System & Troubleshooting (df, prune, events, inspect, debug)

batches.name: Docker Security
batches.description: Securing Docker: image scanning, Dockerfile hardening, runtime security, secrets, rootless mode, CIS benchmark, and container escape testing.
subcategories: Image Scanning (Trivy, Grype, Docker Scout, Dockle)
Runtime Hardening (capabilities, seccomp, AppArmor, read-only, no-new-privileges)
Secrets in Docker (build secrets, BuildKit, anti-patterns)

batches.name: Kubernetes — kubectl Operations
batches.description: Operating Kubernetes with kubectl: workloads, services, config, debugging, contexts, and resource management.
subcategories: Pods & Workloads (get, describe, logs, exec, port-forward)
Debugging & Troubleshooting (events, top, debug, ephemeral containers)
Resource Management (apply, patch, rollout, scale, drain, cordon)

batches.name: Kubernetes Security
batches.description: Securing and attacking Kubernetes: RBAC, Pod Security, network policies, admission control, benchmarks, runtime security, and attack paths.
subcategories: Secrets Security (sealed-secrets, external-secrets, encryption at rest)
Attacking Kubernetes (kube-hunter, kubeletctl, token abuse, privesc)

batches.name: Terraform / IaC Core
batches.description: Terraform workflow: init, plan, apply, state management, workspaces, modules, providers, and debugging.
subcategories: Core Workflow (init, plan, apply, destroy, fmt, validate)
State Management (state list/mv/rm, import, remote backends)

batches.name: IaC Security Scanning
batches.description: Static analysis and policy enforcement for infrastructure-as-code: Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes manifests, and more.

batches.name: Ansible Automation
batches.description: Ansible for configuration management and automation: ad-hoc commands, playbooks, inventory, vault, roles, and security.

batches.name: CI/CD Pipeline Security
batches.description: Securing CI/CD pipelines: GitHub Actions / GitLab CI hardening, secrets scanning, SAST/DAST integration, OIDC, and runner security.
subcategories: GitHub Actions Hardening (permissions, pinning, OIDC, harden-runner)

batches.name: Software Supply Chain Security
batches.description: Supply chain integrity: SBOM generation, artifact signing, provenance/attestation, and dependency vulnerability scanning.

batches.name: Secrets Management
batches.description: Managing and protecting secrets: HashiCorp Vault, SOPS, sealed-secrets, cloud secret managers, and secret detection.
subcategories: HashiCorp Vault (kv, auth, policies, dynamic secrets, transit)

batches.name: Cloud-Native Runtime Security
batches.description: Runtime threat detection and enforcement for containers and hosts using eBPF-based and policy tooling.

batches.name: Cloud Security Posture (Multi-Cloud)
batches.description: Auditing cloud posture across AWS, Azure, and GCP with CSPM and IAM tooling.

batches.name: Helm & Package Management
batches.description: Helm chart operations and security: install, upgrade, templating, repositories, and chart scanning.

batches.name: Service Mesh & Network Security
batches.description: Service mesh operations and zero-trust networking: Istio, Linkerd, Cilium, and mTLS.

batches.name: Observability & Detection Engineering
batches.description: Security observability and detection: log pipelines, SIEM queries, and detection-as-code relevant to DevSecOps.
